benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Rose to about $106.55 on 14 Oct (Trading Economics), up roughly 0.8% on the day, as Bloomberg tanker-tracking data showed supertankers avoiding the Fujairah transfer hub near Hormuz and Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis traded strikes. Week-ago is the 13 Oct value from this site's own prior run.

benchmarks.note: Rose slightly to about $3.29 on 14 Oct (Trading Economics); pre-crisis is the EIA spot price on 27 Feb (FRED). US LNG feedgas and exports are near records, but the US price stays largely insulated from the Hormuz and Red Sea turmoil.

note: Brent and WTI rose about 1% on 14 Oct as Bloomberg tanker-tracking data showed supertankers turning away from the Fujairah transfer hub near Hormuz amid near-daily attacks, and Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis traded strikes after a deadly weekend attack on Riyadh's airport. TTF eased after hitting a new 2026 high the day before. Henry Hub was little changed, insulated from the turmoil.
